name: thingary
description: 物谱 Thingary：物品档案与净资产盘点，本地优先的桌面应用

scripts.test: npm run test:engine && cargo test --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml --features fault-injection --lib --tests
scripts.check: cargo fmt --manifest-path crates/planning-engine/Cargo.toml --check && cargo clippy --locked --manifest-path crates/planning-engine/Cargo.toml --target-dir src-tauri/target/planning-engine --all-targets -- -D warnings && cargo fmt --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml --check && cargo clippy --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml --features fault-injection --all-targets -- -D warnings
scripts.release:win: tauri build --config src-tauri/tauri.release.conf.json --config src-tauri/tauri.windows.release.conf.json --bundles nsis --target x86_64-pc-windows-msvc --ci
